# Model Overview (for Diagnosis)

The probe inspects item embeddings and sequence-conditioned positive/negative scores. It samples real-item rows from `item_emb.weight`, excluding padding and reserved mask tokens. Sequence representations come from `log2feats(sequence)`; `predict_score(features, items)` produces candidate logits at each position.

The supplied file does not show the backbone or final user-representation computation. For the required BERT4Rec contract, inference uses the appended mask at the final nonpadding position; this probe instead evaluates supplied training positions.

# Diagnosis Inputs & Hooks

`DiagnosisProbe(view, device)` receives the compatibility wrapper, stored internally as `self.model`; `view.model` is the trained network. It accesses `item_emb`, `log2feats`, `predict_score`, `meta_data`, `review_data`, and `user_train`. The latter two are stored but unused.

`run_full_diagnosis(train_loader)` reads up to ten batches of `(None, sequence, positive, negative)`, with tensors shaped B × L. It switches to evaluation mode and computes metrics without gradients, retaining positions where the positive ID is nonzero.

# Probes & Metrics

- **`embedding_collapse_score`**: Samples up to 2,048 item embeddings using seed 42, normalizes them, averages off-diagonal cosine similarities, then maps the mean to [0,1]. Higher values indicate stronger directional alignment; approximately 0.5 corresponds to mean cosine zero.
- **`pos_neg_margin_mean` / `pos_neg_margin_p10`**: Mean and lower-tail positive-minus-negative logits. Higher values indicate clearer separation.
- **`pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate`**: Fraction with negative margin; lower is better.
- **`pos_neg_small_margin_rate`**: Fraction below 0.5; lower indicates fewer weakly separated pairs.
- **`pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown`**: Counts low-margin and incorrectly ranked positions, listing up to twenty metadata categories separately for positive and negative items.

# Perturbation & Tests

No sequence shuffling, masking intervention, or sensitivity test is performed. Random embedding subsampling estimates alignment; supplied negative items test pairwise discrimination.

# MODEL_DIAGNOSIS Schema & Limitations

The returned object contains `metrics` and `metric_definitions`. `diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis)` embeds both in instructions requesting a JSON interpretation with status, findings, implications, and evidence.

These are sampled training diagnostics, not validation HR@10. They do not measure order sensitivity, generalization, recommendation diversity, or leakage. Margin magnitudes depend on logit scale. Item categories are unavailable in this task, so category lists should remain empty; zero metrics can also indicate no valid observations.
